title: PIE ANVIL
oneLiner: Dodge the falling anvils and catch as many pies as you can!
mechanics: Move the baker left and right beneath the sky.
Catch pies to score points; falling anvils hurt.
Pies and anvils drop faster and more frequently over time.
Survive and build the highest score before getting crushed.

controls.a: Dash briefly in your current direction

lose: The player loses when hit by a falling anvil.
